title: Roadmap Steward Scoring Model v1 — Rig Relay
description: Heuristic scoring rubric for ranking candidate work slices. Each dimension scored 0-5. Weighted average produces composite score. Steward uses composite + collision analysis + operator input to produce ranked recommendations.

scoring_dimensions.description: Does this slice resolve a known P0 blocker or release gate failure?

scoring_guide.5: Resolves P0 blocker or release gate FAIL

scoring_dimensions.description: Does this slice close a security gap (descriptor integrity, roots, content-light, auth, injection, supply-chain)?

scoring_guide.5: Closes critical security gap (mutation gate, injection, credential leak)

scoring_dimensions.description: Does this slice move Rig Relay closer to canonical cross-surface authority spine compliance?

scoring_guide.5: Aligns multiple surfaces or closes major authority gap

scoring_dimensions.description: Does this slice improve governance evidence discoverability, receipt manifest enrichment, or DuckDB replay projection?
Does this slice advance a declared roadmap phase (enterprise procurement, Postgres, GitHub Trust Spine, etc.)?

scoring_guide.2: On a roadmap but not prioritized

scoring_dimensions.description: Is the implementation path clear? Are affected files known, tests designed, acceptance criteria defined?

scoring_guide.5: Spec + tests + validation command all defined

scoring_dimensions.description: Can the slice be validated with targeted tests without running the full suite?

scoring_guide.0: Requires full suite or manual validation
scoring_guide.5: Release gate script exists with pass/fail output

scoring_dimensions.description: Are the files touched by this slice free from active parallel lane edits?

scoring_guide.0: Touches files with active parallel lane edits (collision risk)
scoring_guide.5: Documentation only — no code files touched

scoring_dimensions.description: Can this slice be completed on a typical developer laptop without excessive CPU/memory/network cost?

scoring_guide.0: Requires cloud GPU or large-scale infrastructure
scoring_guide.3: Runs locally but expensive (full suite, large builds)
scoring_guide.5: Runs on a laptop, sub-second feedback loop

scoring_dimensions.description: Does this slice add new dependencies, change the dependency graph, or risk supply-chain issues?
Does this slice improve the product's visible surface (cockpit, website, static docs, onboarding)?

scoring_guide.4: Improves user-facing cockpit or static site
scoring_guide.5: Improves product front door or onboarding

scoring_dimensions.description: Does this slice directly address an enterprise procurement blocker or security review requirement?

scoring_guide.5: Directly resolves a documented procurement blocker

scoring_dimensions.description: Has the human operator explicitly requested this slice?
